feeds.title: Cult Kits Blog
feeds.description: Celebrating the Cult football players of the beautiful game, vintage football shirts, and current football news. The Voice of the cult is the destination of football nostalgia as well as a place for fans to read about newly released kits and boots from brands such as Umbro, Nike, Puma, Adidas, Kappa, and many more.

feeds.title: Vintage Football Shirts
feeds.description: Vintagefootballshirts.com was founded in 2010 with a desire to turn a passion for football shirts into a web-based business. Since then, the site has become one of the market leaders in online sales of rare, original, vintage football shirts with customers as far afield as America, Australia, and Asia.Their blog provides you with all the information about the company, their products, and articles on football jerseys.

feeds.title: Football Kit Geek
feeds.description: 'KitGeek' is a blog dedicated to showcasing and reviewing football kits from various clubs and countries around the world. The blog provides a detailed analysis of each kit, including design, colors, patterns, and materials used. The blog also covers news and updates related to football kits, such as new releases, leaked designs, and more.

feeds.title: Football Fashion
feeds.description: Football Fashion publishes news about the world's greatest game, football. Originally focused on new soccer jersey launches, the site has grown to incorporate many more aspects of the Beautiful Game including game highlights, transfers and new signings, and much more. We've also conducted many soccer product tests and have posted the results in our Product Reviews section.

feeds.title: Football Shirt Culture
feeds.description: Football Shirt Culture is the world's first and longest-running football kits and product news website. Football Shirt Culture has been bringing football kit fans the latest release news since 2006, as well as being a home to hundreds of features on the fandom and the industry in the last decade and a half. In association with sister websites such as DesignFootball.com, FSC continues to carry content relating to football shirts from reality and fantasy, with concept and virtual releases also given the spotlight when appropriate.

feeds.title: Club 25 Football
feeds.description: Club 25 was originally conceived in late 2016 when its founder was living in Singapore. Seeing and experiencing the unbridled passion of other football shirt collectors for their shared hobby inspired him to contribute and give back to the many individuals that make up the global collector fraternity.

feeds.title: The Kit Rail Blog
feeds.description: It's here you will find all of the featured kits that have been posted on the website. Feel free to like or comment on any tops that you enjoyed and feel free to share the page. Follow My Blog Get new content delivered directly to your inbox.

feeds.title: Dezeen » Football Kits
feeds.description: The Dezeen's football kits section shares Stories about football kits including the design of strips worn by soccer teams, the graphic design of shirts and apparel materials and technology. Dezeen is the world's most popular and influential architecture, interiors and design magazine, with over three million monthly readers and six million social media followers.

feeds.title: Footy Headlines
feeds.description: All new football kits and boots. Exclusive Leaks, all football kit releases and leaks - ahead of the game.

feeds.title: FootballFansGo
feeds.description: The ultimate online destination where the legacy of football meets the timeless appeal of classic shirts. Dive into a rich tapestry of stories behind the iconic jerseys that have graced the world's pitches, and relive the glory days of football's past.
